# krakenkey_endpoint (Data Source)

Reads a monitored endpoint by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "krakenkey_endpoint" "existing" {
  id = "3f0c9a52-6b1e-4d8a-9c47-2e5f1b7d8a90"
}

output "regions" {
  value = data.krakenkey_endpoint.existing.hosted_regions
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Endpoint UUID.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time, RFC 3339.
- `host` (String) Hostname being scanned.
- `hosted_regions` (List of String) Hosted probe regions that scan this endpoint. Manage them with krakenkey_endpoint_region.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether scanning is on.
- `label` (String) Display label.
- `port` (Number) Port being scanned.
- `sni` (String) SNI override, if one is set.
